items.claim: Wellington has not fought in three years.
items.quote: He hasn't fought in three years.

items.claim: Wellington has not won in four years.
items.quote: He hasn't won in four years.

items.claim: Ramazan Temirov is a lightning fast striker with crazy power.
items.quote: He's a lightning fast striker. He's got tiny little legs. He's not a big dude but he's got crazy power.

items.claim: Ramazan Temirov can be rocked but continues to fight through adversity.
items.quote: it doesn't take a ton of tape study to see that he can be rocked, but he just weathers, he moves forward, and he continues to fight.

items.claim: Steve Erceg does not have good wins on his record.
items.quote: You know who does not have good wins? Steve Erceg.

items.claim: Steve Erceg lost to an old Brandon Moreno and got smoked by Kai Kara-France.
items.quote: Loses to an old Brandon Moreno, gets smoked by Kai Kara-France
